# Sun Robotics & AI

> Sun Robotics & AI is a robotics and software company in Indore, India.

Sun Robotics & AI is developing a modular robotic arm and a humanoid robot.
It makes SunBot Vision AI, a camera-based system that flags defective parts
on a production line. Its software division, Sun IT Services, builds
websites, iOS and Android apps, APIs, dashboards and cloud hosting for
businesses in Indore and across India.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://sunroboticsandai.in/): Overview of the robotics work and Sun IT Services.
- [About](https://sunroboticsandai.in/about): What the company does and where it is.
- [Contact](https://sunroboticsandai.in/contact): Address, phone, email, and contact form.
- [Careers](https://sunroboticsandai.in/careers): Open positions.

## Robotics

- [Robotics](https://sunroboticsandai.in/robotics): Status of the modular robotic arm and humanoid platform (both in development) and SunBot Vision AI.
- [Products](https://sunroboticsandai.in/products): SunBot Vision AI, automated visual inspection for production lines.

## Sun IT Services

- [Sun IT Services](https://sunroboticsandai.in/sunitservices): Website development (React, Next.js), iOS and Android apps (React Native, Flutter), backend APIs, dashboards, and cloud hosting on AWS or GCP. Client work includes PRYME Loans, ProtoDesign Studio and 911 Fashion.
